content.title: Flowing-Noodle Relay | Missed Catch, Partner Correction and Social Recovery
content.summary: An adult apprentice misses one moving noodle and an adult gardener completes the catch. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: Both human subjects are clearly adult. + One continuous channel direction anchors the interaction. + Exactly one failed catch and one successful catch occur. + The second subject corrects rather than replaces the first subject's identity. + The final reactions close the social consequence.
quick_start.recommended_input: One clearly adult original sky-garden apprentice stands beside a glass water channel with chopsticks ready. She freezes for one embarrassed beat while the same water and noodle direction continue. The gardener holds up the noodle; the apprentice blushes, bows once and both remain beside the channel.

creative_dna.mechanism: 完整原视频并非候选阶段误写的银河米饭，而是流水素面互动：一名成年食客连续尝试却失手，另一名成年同伴进入并一次夹住面条，前者以羞赧反应完成社交闭环。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: Both human subjects are clearly adult.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "Both human subjects are clearly adult."

invariants.rule: One continuous channel direction anchors the interaction.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "One continuous channel direction anchors the interaction."

invariants.rule: Exactly one failed catch and one successful catch occur.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Exactly one failed catch and one successful catch occur."

invariants.rule: The second subject corrects rather than replaces the first subject's identity.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The second subject corrects rather than replaces the first subject's identity."

invariants.rule: The final reactions close the social consequence.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final reactions close the social consequence."
